description.value: Gina's Sandwich & Coffee is a cafe located in Maple Ridge, BC, operating out of unit 110 of a local commercial building. The business appears to be a recent rebranding of the former Sushi Eben-Ezer, now offering sandwiches and coffee. It sits along a cycling-accessible corridor in Maple Ridge, making it a potential stop for riders passing through the community.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 20m; rack at 26m; rack at 44m; rack at 75m.
